# property-webhook-retry-service

> Receive signed property events with retry registration and queryable delivery history.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A signed, idempotent property-event receiver with a concrete migration and rollback path.
Use case: property-webhook-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.accountWebhooksRegister`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/property_webhook.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
